definitions.explanation: A soldier or guard stationed to keep watch over a place, standing guard at an entrance, gate, or post to detect intruders.

examples.english: A sentry is standing in front of the gate.

examples.japanese: {番兵|ばんぺい}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{夜通|よどお}し→夜通し：12169_yodooshi⟧⟦{見張|みは}り→見張り：18525_mihari⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The sentry keeps watch all night long.

examples.japanese: ⟦{城|しろ}→城：03255_shiro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{番兵|ばんぺい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{不審|ふしん}→不審：16934_fushin⟧な⟦{人物|じんぶつ}→人物：03356_jinbutsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{見|み}つけて→見つける：01180_mitsukeru⟧⟦{呼|よ}び{止|と}めた→呼び止める：29661_yobitomeru⟧。
examples.english: The castle sentry spotted a suspicious person and called out to stop them.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{番|ばん}→番：09873_ban⟧ (watch, guard duty) + ⟦{兵|へい}→兵：29510_hei⟧ (soldier). Refers to a soldier posted to stand guard; common in historical and military contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {番兵|ばんぺい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{置|お}く→置く：01092_oku⟧: to post a sentry
- {番兵|ばんぺい}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}つ→立つ：00758_tatsu⟧: to stand guard
- {番兵|ばんぺい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{交代|こうたい}→交代：14943_koutai⟧: changing of the guard

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {歩哨|ほしょう}: sentinel — more technical, formal military term
- ⟦{見張|みは}り→見張る：18224_miharu⟧: lookout — general watching, not necessarily a soldier
